## Summary

**No blocking offences found.** The codebase is well-prepared for this work:

- **The seam is open:** `NativeBackend` already documents platform-specific behavior (iOS Done vs Android back keyboard dismiss, attribute/value vs attribute/text readback). The skeleton anticipated `UiAutomator2Backend` as "purely additive."
- **Schema is ready:** `NativeSnapshot.platform` already accepts both `'ios'` and `'android'`; `FakeNativeBackend` recognizes all press keys including Android `back`.
- **Reference implementation exists:** `AppiumBackend` (~600 LOC) demonstrates the pattern: W3C WebDriver transport, XML parsing, platform-specific key handling, keyboard dismiss logic.
- **CLI exists but incomplete:** `bin/leonard_native_host.dart` accepts `--platform` but always instantiates `AppiumBackend`. The architect needs to wire platform-conditional backend selection.

**Key facts for the architect:**
- Test environment needs Android-specific env vars (`LEONARD_NATIVE_APP_PACKAGE`, `LEONARD_NATIVE_APP_ACTIVITY` instead of `LEONARD_NATIVE_APP`)
- Auth0 divergence: iOS has a separate SpringBoard consent alert; Android uses Chrome Custom Tab (no separate alert)
- Keyboard dismiss: iOS uses Done button or no-op (iOS26), Android uses `POST /back` (non-fatal per spec)
- Attribute readback: iOS reads `attribute/value`, Android reads `attribute/text`

The report file documents line-by-line references for every design detail the architect will need.
